free_tier.stated: Starter 50 GB ₹20/mo; Freelancer 100 GB ₹35/mo; 500 GB ₹100/mo; Studio Pro 1 TB ₹150/mo (or ₹1,650/yr); 25 GB free forever. Enterprise pooled storage on request.

egress.terms: Claimed free. The business page is titled «Eliminate Egress Fees» and argues against providers «that charge hidden egress fees», and the pricing JSON-LD implies flat-rate. But no numbered egress allowance, no fair-use clause and no overage rate is published anywhere on the site. So the claim cannot be falsified from outside.

record.tooling: None documented. No public API, no WebDAV, no S3 endpoint, no rclone backend, no CLI. The product page describes «Zero-Knowledge Personal Vault», AES-256-GCM client-side encryption, mobile sync and a web UI. This is the disqualifying gap.
record.chaining: Per-account consumer plans; no documented route that uses several accounts and no API to automate one.
record.limits_note: Zero programmatic API access. Client-side zero-knowledge encryption ensures that stored data is encrypted prior to transmission. Marketing comparison pages advertise promotional pricing while direct pricing endpoints returned incomplete placeholder pages on 2026-10-21.
record.reliability_note: unverified: https://spacebyte.in/cloud-storage-pricing, / and /pricing answered HTTP 503 with a maintenance notice on 2026-11-03; routes tried: four reader pins, a direct fetch, the archive (none for the pricing page) and a probe.
record.confidence_note: no plan page could be read on 2026-11-03: https://spacebyte.in/cloud-storage-pricing, the site root and /pricing answered HTTP 503 with a maintenance notice (probe:spacebyte.in); the plan prices date from 2026-10-21 and no page states them now

evidence.proved: «1TB of high-speed cloud storage on SpaceByte costs just ₹150/month with zero foreign exchange credit card markups»; «25 GB Permanent Free Storage»; «Pay in Indian Rupees using PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM UPI, and RuPay from ₹20/month»

«SpaceByte’s transparent, tiered approach … Starter: 50GB for ₹20/month. Freelancer: 100GB for ₹35/month. Studio Pro: 1TB for ₹150/month»; page title «Eliminate Egress Fees, Ensure Compliance, and Scale Infinitely»
probe: curl -> HTTP 403 in 0.44 s; no S3/WebDAV/REST endpoint exists to probe
the pricing page URL answered HTTP 503 on 2026-11-03; the captured body of the site root, /pricing and the guide page is a maintenance notice

record.price_per_tb_month: $1.58/TB/mo at 1 TB ($18.95/TB/yr) as advertised, $1.19/TB/mo on the ₹1,650/yr annual. At 5 TB and 20 TB: NO PUBLISHED PLAN — the ladder stops at 1 TB and «Enterprise pooled storage» is quote-only, so the 5 TB and 20 TB figures do not exist and the number cannot be used for the sizing.
